deadlines.dateText: This year, subject to approval by the relevant committees, the application period starts on 1 April and ends on 15 May. The [Admissions Office](https://www.uni-mannheim.de/en/academics/before-your-studies/applying/masters-program/?mtm_campaign=DAAD-MSoc) is the central office for all applicants (German as well as international applicants).
